# Long Haul — nested repeats, repeat 0, comments and blank lines
# expect: KKGGGGWGKK
SIZE 4
# comments and blank lines are ignored, even inside blocks
SET 0 0 R
ROW 3 B

REPEAT 0
  FILL W
END
REPEAT 1
  REPEAT 2
    # nothing here
  END
  REPEAT 3
    CYCLE
    REPEAT 2
      CHASE
    END
  END
END
SET 3 1 G
